controls the cluster manager.

Usage:

  kubectl [flags] <command> [command arguments]

The command groups are:

  pods        manages the pods.

The commands are:

  version     prints the version.

Flags:

  -u, --username string  the user to authenticate as. [env: KUBECTL_USERNAME]
  -h, --help             shows this help message.

Use "kubectl <command> --help" for more information about a command.
